summary: The agent implements a working LightGBM regressor but introduces critical data leakage flaws. Specifically, it scales the combined train and test data prior to splitting, leaking test distribution statistics into the training pipeline. Moreover, it concatenates the provided train and test sets only to split them with an arbitrary 80/20 slice, which risks leaking actual test samples into the training set if the original split ratio was not exactly 80/20. The solution also lacks any feature engineering and relies on a single metric and a single evaluation run.
